ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity predominance; approximately 90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 10% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous blob across both lobes; localized high-contrast white patch at the inferior margin of the right lobe; white punctate clusters at the distal extremity of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated 45-60 degree convergence angle; the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations and jagged peaks; right lobe displays low-frequency, smooth undulating topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe presents a linear, diagonal ascending sweep; right lobe presents a broad, convex elliptical curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups located on the distal left tip and scattered across the mid-region of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contour disruption and potential tissue loss along the distal half of the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced three-dimensional high-contrast protrusions (barnacle-like structures) extending beyond the planar boundary of the left lobe tip.
